info.title: PikaAI backend
info.description: Prisma-backed local authentication and membership-scoped organizations, workspaces, and text documents. Signed Bearer access tokens expire after 900 seconds by default. Redis is required for revocation, shared rate limits, and recent IP/user-agent activity. Registration does not verify email ownership. Documents have GET and POST operations only; RAG is deferred. General limits default to 100 requests/minute/IP; registration and login share an additional 10 attempts/15 minutes/IP. All lists use newest-first ordering, with ID as the tie-breaker.
